questions.stem: Group 0 elements (noble gases) are described as unreactive. Why is this?

options.text: Because they are all gases at room temperature
Because they have the same number of protons and neutrons
Because they have full outer electron shells

questions.explanation: Noble gases have full outer electron shells (8 electrons, or 2 for helium). Since they already have a stable electron arrangement, they do not need to gain, lose, or share electrons, making them very unreactive.
